wikitext: {{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Model SS= File:SS Wooden Mop Model.png |Model SSHD= File:SSHD Wooden Mop Model.png |Model BotW= File:BotW Wooden Mop Model.png |Model TotK= File:TotK Wooden Mop Model.png |Sprite BotW= File:BotW Wooden Mop Icon.png |Sprite TotK= File:TotK Wooden Mop Icon.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |plural= |game= SS, BotW, TotK |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= {{Infobox Game Blocks |SS= [[Knight Academy]] |BotW= [[East Necluda]], [[Hyrule Field]] }} |uses= Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] |strength= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 5 }} |durability= {{Infobox Game Blocks |BotW= 8 }} |comp= |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Wooden Mop|Wooden Mops|Series, BotW, TotK, AoC|plural}} are recurring [[Item]]s and [[Object]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK, AoC}} Therefore, they can be found in villages such as [[Hateno Village]] and ruins within [[East Necluda]] and [[Hyrule Field]]. Despite their intended purpose, Wooden Mops have a sturdy construction, giving them some merit in combat. Being made of [[Wood]], Wooden Mops will float when dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. They are also unable to conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] when equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s, but they will burn when exposed to a [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].
